page.layout: One page of text in a single column; in the right margin, marginal notes beside the lines at the foot of the page (Quaestiones variae de intellectus impotentia, and "I. Cur tam impotens"). Running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: tetigeram, mihi motae sunt aliquando a Generoso quodam Veritatis solidioris Amatore; ea propter non pigebit nunc ex istiusmodi quaestionibus magis praecipuas hic subnectere enodatas, veritatesque momentosas, quas lectores vel ob minorem attentionem, vel ob habitus & praejudicia adversa, vel ob proclivitatem nostram ad partes oppositas, vel ob minorem in his exercitationem, facile, tametsi perceptas, oblivisci possent, vividius si potero, inculcare, nonnullasque pluribus modis, quo possint ipsis esse exemplorum vel exercitii loco, in quibus se aliquamdiu optem ut exerceant, donec haecce mentibus aeternis vere digna vereque proficua materia, aliquantum ipsis fiat familiarior.
main_text.head: PARS ALTERA.

p.i: Ubi varia quaestiones & difficultates de intellectus impotentia, quiete, passivitate, de Dei in illo actione & lumine, deque ejus statu divinior & medio ad illum proximo, enodantur.

main_text.head: I. De impotentia Intellectus.
main_text.p: QUaeritur primo, cur tanta praedicetur Intellectus impotentia, siquidem experientia constet eum plurimas veritates, tam circa divina quam circa naturalia, circa sui & erga Deum, erga se, erga alios regimen Quaestiones variae de intellectus impotentia offi-cia I. Cur tam impotens d

page.notes: The main-column text is set in italic and roman mixed type; the right-margin notes are small and partly cut off at the line ends. Several words in the last lines are doubtful, notably "fiat", "praejudicia", and the marginal note text. The column ends in a damaged line with "offi-" and "potens" printed beside it. Lower-right faint watermark and a dot at the foot were ignored.
